experiment_data.hypothesis: If Smart Compress's 15pp gain over baseline (59.8% vs 44.8%) comes from cross-attention re-encoding rather than extra training, then continuing baseline training for another 100K steps (expert-only, no compressor) should NOT close the gap. If baseline+100K reaches ~60%, the gain was from training; if it stays near 44.8%, cross-attention architecture is the cause.
